guide.title: How to add a video
guide.youtube1: In YouTube Studio, click 'Create → Upload videos'.
guide.youtube2: Set visibility to 'Unlisted' — only people with the link can watch, and it won't appear in search. 'Private' videos won't play.
guide.youtube3: Click 'Share → Copy link' under the video.
guide.youtube4: Paste the link above. Both youtu.be and watch?v= links work.
guide.drive1: Upload the video file to Drive.
guide.drive2: Right-click → 'Share', and set General access to 'Anyone with the link · Viewer'.
guide.drive3: Click 'Copy link' and paste it above.
guide.tip: Tip: a 1–3 minute walkthrough of the core features works best. Viewers decide within the first 30 seconds.

NO_README.label: No README
NO_README.guide: Add an overview, how to run it, and the tech stack so visitors can understand the project.

NO_DESCRIPTION.label: No description or topics
NO_DESCRIPTION.guide: Add a one-line description and topics in the repo's About section.

NO_HOMEPAGE.label: No deploy link
NO_HOMEPAGE.guide: If it's deployed, add the URL to Website in About — a live demo stands out.

NO_TESTS.label: No tests
NO_TESTS.guide: No test folder found. Start by testing one core feature.

TOO_FEW_COMMITS.label: Too few commits
TOO_FEW_COMMITS.guide: Two commits or fewer. If it's practice, consider making it private or archiving it.

WEAK_COMMIT_MESSAGES.label: Weak commit messages
WEAK_COMMIT_MESSAGES.guide: Most recent commits say little ("update", "fix"). Describe what changed and why.

ENV_FILE_COMMITTED.label: .env file committed
ENV_FILE_COMMITTED.guide: A .env file is in the repo root. If it holds secrets, rotate them now, delete the file, and add it to .gitignore. Keep a .env.example instead.

NO_CI.label: No CI
NO_CI.guide: No automated build or test setup such as GitHub Actions. Running tests on every push shows automation experience.

README_NO_RUN_GUIDE.label: No run instructions in README
README_NO_RUN_GUIDE.guide: The README does not say how to install or run the project. Add commands a newcomer can copy.

NO_LOCKFILE.label: No lockfile
NO_LOCKFILE.guide: There is a package.json but no lockfile (package-lock.json, yarn.lock …). Commit one so every install gets the same versions.

NO_LINT_CONFIG.label: No linter / formatter config
NO_LINT_CONFIG.guide: No ESLint or Prettier config at the root. Enforcing style with tools shows good collaboration habits.

FORK_HEAVY.label: Mostly forks
FORK_HEAVY.guide: Under 30% of your repos are your own. Try starting a small personal project.

NO_PROFILE_README.label: No profile README
NO_PROFILE_README.guide: A README in the repo named after your username shows on your GitHub profile.
